servicesIntro: One-time details, regular programs and long-lasting protection.

services.name: Teak Cleaning
services.text: Regular cleaning and treating keeps teak at its natural luster and stops mold, buildup and discoloration.

services.name: Washes
services.text: One-time detailed washes as needed, or recurring washes every one, two, three or four weeks to keep your boat ready year-round.

services.name: Detail
services.text: Buff and polish removes oxidation, brings back the gloss and protects your gel coat so the boat is easier to clean.

why.name: Every boat gets its own approach
why.text: From wet sanding, buff and polish on heavily oxidized boats to a simple buff and wax on lightly oxidized ones.

why.name: A test spot first
why.text: We always test a spot to see which approach will give the best results.

why.name: Easy to schedule
why.text: Fast, easy scheduling and a free estimate based on your needs.

howTitle: Ready for the water in three steps.

steps.name: Tell us about your boat

steps.name: We set the plan
steps.text: One-time detail or a regular wash plan, your choice.

steps.name: Back on the water
